title.zh: Sam Bankman-Fried asks Supreme Court to overturn fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture
title.en: Sam Bankman-Fried asks Supreme Court to overturn fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture

current_state.zh: Sam Bankman-Fried has petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn his fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture, arguing he was unfairly barred from presenting evidence that FTX held enough assets to cover losses from its collapse.
current_state.en: Sam Bankman-Fried has petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn his fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture, arguing he was unfairly barred from presenting evidence that FTX held enough assets to cover losses from its collapse.
